dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus, forming a smooth curvilinear taper.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical bulge observed on the left lateral margin; right margin presents a uniform convex edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mid-range slate grey; uniform pigmentation across the visible dorsal plane excluding localized anomalies.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High density of light-colored linear and curvilinear streaks across the dorsal surface, creating a complex textural map against the darker baseline.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Relatively sharp boundaries between the light-colored linear marks and the dark grey epidermal background.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Extensive network of white linear marks and intersecting rake-like scars distributed across the central and anterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, intersecting light-grey linear scars (rake marks) of varying lengths and widths across the dorsal plane.
